_text: [mischievous] You borrow every bee she owns. In a SHOEBOX. [dramatic, alarmed] But by Friday, Derek's at ninety-nine percent, and your new bud is turning brown. [urgent, building] At the debate, you shout "He's a fake!", and the whole park laughs at the *flake*. [dramatic, loud] So you lift the *lid*. [dramatic, booming] Ten thousand bees POUR out, onto every real flower in the park. [building excitement] Linda's knee. The mailman's elbow. Grandma's *roses*. [loud, deadpan punchline] Every flower... except *Derek's*. [excited, realizing] You see, all summer you've watched those bees, and they NEVER, ever land on Derek.
